# FitCheck AI

> FitCheck AI is a free Android app that gives friendly AI feedback on outfits, makeup and hair from a photo: an outfit score with notes on color, fit and balance. Outfit scoring is processed directly on your device; a few optional AI features (hairstyle previews, AI try-on, Premium diagnostics) send the chosen photo to a third-party AI service. An iPhone version is coming soon.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/): What FitCheck does and where to download it
- [How it works](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/how-it-works.html): The three steps, what the score looks at, limits and photo tips
- [About FitCheck](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/about/): What the app is for, what it does and does not do
- [AI outfit checker](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/ai-outfit-checker/): Rate an outfit from a photo
- [AI makeup assistant](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/ai-makeup-assistant/): Live camera makeup guidance
- [AI hairstyle try-on](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/ai-hairstyle-try-on/): Hairstyle and hair color ideas on your own photo
- [AI skin analysis](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/ai-skin-analysis/): Cosmetic skin overview from the camera
- [Digital wardrobe](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/digital-wardrobe/): Save and organize favorite looks
- [Virtual outfit try-on](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/virtual-outfit-try-on/): AI previews of you in different outfits
- [App comparisons](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/compare/): How FitCheck compares with other style apps
- [Best style apps compared](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/compare/best-style-apps/): Side-by-side comparison of five style and wardrobe apps, based on their Google Play listings
- [Style guides](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/): Practical outfit, color, makeup and hair guides

## Style guides
- [Grey Looks Good With What Color? Easy Pairings by Shade and Piece](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/what-colors-go-with-grey/): Learn which colors go with grey, from safe neutrals to bold accents, with pairings by shade, garment, accessory and occasion.
- [Haircuts for a Heart-Shaped Face: What Works, What to Watch and What to Ask For](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/haircuts-for-heart-shaped-face/): A practical guide to haircuts for a heart-shaped face: bobs, lobs, layers, fringes and parts, men's options, what to be careful with, and how to brief your hairdresser.
- [Fitzpatrick Skin Type Test: An Informal Self-Quiz and What Your Result Means](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/fitzpatrick-skin-type-test/): Try an informal Fitzpatrick skin type self-quiz, learn what types I to VI mean and where the scale falls short, and see why undertone and depth matter more for makeup and color choices.
- [What Colors Go With Burgundy? Outfit Pairings That Work](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/what-colors-go-with-burgundy/): Find out which neutrals, accent colors, shoes and metals go with burgundy, with outfit formulas for women and men and the combinations to avoid.
- [Haircut for Round Face Men: Best Styles, What to Avoid and What to Ask Your Barber](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/haircut-for-round-face-men/): A practical guide to the best haircuts for men with round faces, from fades and quiffs to beards and a barber-ready brief.
- [Hair Styles for Curly Hair: Cuts and Ideas for Every Length](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/hair-styles-for-curly-hair/): A practical guide to curly hairstyles by length, occasion and routine, with tips for briefing your hairdresser and previewing a cut first.
- [What Color Undertones Do I Have? 5 Simple Tests to Find Out](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/what-color-undertones-do-i-have/): Learn how to find out whether you have cool, warm, neutral or olive undertones with five at-home tests, plus which clothing, jewelry and makeup colors to try first.
- [Color Matching Clothes for Ladies: A Simple Guide to Outfits That Work](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/color-matching-clothes-for-women/): A practical guide to color matching women's outfits, covering neutrals, color wheel basics, a simple 60-30-10 formula, prints, accessories and fixes for outfits that feel off.
- [How to Test Hair Porosity at Home (and What to Do With the Result)](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/how-to-test-hair-porosity/): Learn three simple at-home methods to test hair porosity, how to read the results honestly, and how to use them to choose products and a hairstyle.
- [AI Clothing Try-On: How to See Yourself in an Outfit Before You Commit](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/ai-clothing-try-on-guide/): Learn what AI clothing try-on can and can't show, how to get a realistic preview from your own photo, and how to turn it into real outfit decisions.
- [Makeup Virtual Try-On: How to Preview a Look That Actually Helps](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/makeup-virtual-try-on-guide/): A practical guide to makeup virtual try-ons: how they work, how to set up for a realistic preview, and how to turn a look into real makeup.
- [What Haircut Will Look Good on Me? A 5-Step Way to Choose](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/what-haircut-looks-good-on-me/): A five-step guide to choosing a haircut that suits your hair type, face, features and routine, with a way to preview your shortlist before you cut.
- [How to Tell if Your Outfit Looks Good](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/does-my-outfit-look-good/): A practical guide to judging your own outfit, with a mirror and photo test, a 7-point checklist, a symptom-and-fix table and occasion tips.
- [What Is My Hair Type? A 5-Question Quiz to Find Out](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/what-is-my-hair-type-quiz/): Take a five-question quiz to find your hair pattern, strand thickness and density, then learn which cuts and styles tend to suit your hair.
- [What Makeup Suits My Face? A 6-Question Self-Guided Quiz](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/what-makeup-suits-my-face/): A self-guided six-question quiz that turns your undertone, contrast, face shape, eyes, lips, and finish preference into a simple makeup profile you can test at home.
- [How to Organize Your Closet: A 6-Step Method That Lasts](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/how-to-organize-your-closet/): A practical six-step method for decluttering, grouping, storing and maintaining your closet, plus ideas for turning what you keep into outfits.
- [What Should I Wear Today? A Quick 5-Step Way to Decide](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/what-should-i-wear-today/): A quick 5-step method, weather and occasion guidance and reusable outfit formulas to help you decide what to wear today.
- [What Is My Skin Tone? How to Find Your Depth and Undertone](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/what-is-my-skin-tone/): A practical guide to finding your skin tone depth and undertone at home, with simple checks and ways to use your result for clothes, makeup and hair color.
- [How to Try Hairstyles on Your Face Before You Commit to a Cut](https://fitcheck-fashion.com/blog/try-hairstyles-on-your-face/): A practical guide to previewing a haircut on your own photo, judging the result honestly, and turning it into a clear brief for your hairdresser.
